description: Returns the carrier's official tracking page link for a waybill number (AWB, накладна, трек-номер). Use when the user wants to track a shipment. Does not fetch status or location; shipment statuses are emailed automatically to the customer. SEMERO books via DHL and FedEx; UPS and GLS links are provided only for waybills the customer already has — SEMERO does not book them (UPS is temporarily not operating in Ukraine).
name: tracking_link
title: Посилання відстеження
